summary: Halifax tower in Halifax County is listed as gone; the only source found is the Association's list, with no build, owner or removal detail.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. No source read describes the tower or its removal.

evidence.supports: Listed as a tower, gone, in Halifax County under the name Halifax, at latitude 36.77959 and longitude -78.90574

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: one inventory entry is the only source for this tower, so the story is about 50 words and is below the usual 120-word length; it was not padded with statewide background. Searches and reads (firetower.org Virginia index, the Association's Virginia pages, the 2020 Virginia chapter report, and several general pages) found no page naming this tower. A search snippet from an older (2011) version of the Association's list showed a 'Halifax (name unconfirmed)' entry at about the same coordinates with unknown status; it could not be quoted from a fetched page, so it is not in the story and is a lead worth checking. Do not confuse with Halifax County, North Carolina, where a 1933 newspaper reported a planned lookout tower; that is unrelated. The brief's access 'unknown' is kept unset.
